params.name: q
params.description: Search query. The term(s) you are searching for. Format: URL-encoded string. For example: To search for Testing String, use Testing%20string

params.name: number
params.description: Which page of results to return. For example, to return the page with the 60th result, when there are 50 results per page (size), submit 2 to return the 2nd page of results. Max value: N/A

params.name: size
params.description: Page size: maximum number of search results per page. Max value: 250

params.name: sort
params.description: A URL-encoded value that defines how to sort the results. The supported values are +lastModified or -lastModified to sort by ascending/descending respectively.

items.docs: Search a unified index of content derived from a user's connected accounts. Requires a user-based token.
